title: Software
text:
Open-source tools I have developed or contributed to.

PortinariColors · Author and maintainer · Oct 2026–present (CRAN)
Color palettes inspired by paintings of Candido Portinari held by the São Paulo Museum of Art (MASP) and by his Guerra (War) and Paz (Peace) panels at the United Nations Headquarters.
nowcaster · Lead developer · 2022–present
Open R package implementing Bayesian hierarchical correction for reporting delay in disease surveillance. Used by Brazil’s Ministry of Health for dengue, chikungunya, Zika, COVID-19, and RSV.
Observatório COVID-19 BR · Contributor · 2020–2022
Open modeling and data platform for the Brazilian COVID-19 response.

title: Rafael Lopes
text:
I’m a computational epidemiologist at Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB) at the Spatial Epidemiology Lab (SpELL) working on climate change impact into infectious diseases.
By training I’m either a physicist (specializing in mathematical and statistical modelling for disease transmission and spread) or environmental and climate epidemiologist; professionally, I’ve worked as a data scientist, full stack developer and barista. Outside of work, I like drawing maps and drinking coffee.
On this site I keep a list of my CV
